title: query type-usage
summary: Answers one question, of a list of type names, about one file
intro: Read this when you have a set of type names, such as types you are about to retire, and need to know whether one file really references any of them. Give it the file and the names; it answers for that one file.

help: of these type names, which does THIS file actually REFERENCE? Answers a
LIST in one pass (an RTL surface, say). Counts declarations, X.Create
construction sites and inheritance; a name appearing only in a COMMENT or
a STRING LITERAL is correctly not a reference -- which is the difference
from grep. Name-keyed: a project type sharing an RTL name is
indistinguishable, and the output says so.
